supersession_reason: V8 was rejected on selection: causal safe success was 2644/2880 (91.81%) with 43/2880 (1.49%) violations and a 93.23% held-out reverse rate, but its gain over the unstructured GRU was 4.51 points, below the frozen 5-point floor. On the opened 337000000 development family, a declared screen of three already-trained reverse controllers selected the seed-4796 handoff checkpoint at 188/192 (97.92%) safe reverse recoveries and zero violations. V9 changes only that shared option-2 checkpoint and reserves fresh outcome families.
research_question: Can calibrated causal evidence and factorized supervision compose a held-out recovery option when every router shares a seed-robust handoff specialist?

representation.name: complete_current_centered_causal_motion
representation.definition: At each decision, subtract the current 57-D task geometry from every geometry frame in the causal prefix; the final geometry is identically zero for every method.
representation.runtime_causality: Uses only stored observations at or before the current decision.

episode_resolution.rule: Score and mask an environment at its first native success or constraint violation; a simultaneous success and violation is unsafe.

defer_policy.release_rule: Release defer when the method's calibrated posterior confirms nominal option 0; a later observed event may revise nominal or hand off irreversibly to a specialist.

shared_option_controllers.matching_rule: The exact nominal ensemble, temporary checkpoint, and reverse handoff checkpoint are shared by causal, static, unstructured, heuristic, and oracle routers.

readme_release_rule: Promote the primary V9 result only if every primary, OOD, external, seed-count, and anti-shortcut criterion passes on untouched 342000000. An A/A+ general-method claim additionally requires the external PegInsertion closed-loop gate.
